findings: `components[1]` and the corresponding learner card treat 一 as a separate pictorial component, but the cited analysis describes it as the mark that was later reduced to a horizontal stroke. That supports explaining the head-marked early form and its graphic simplification, not assigning the modern character 一 as an independently pictorial component. Represent the early whole graph as one pictorial component, or otherwise make clear that 一 is only the later visible form of the head mark.
